aboutBio.heading: About me
aboutBio.paragraph1: I’m Luan Vitor de Campos Oliveira, also known as Vitor. I’m a senior full-stack developer working on software architecture and hands-on implementation.
aboutBio.paragraph2: At Embalalab and Kyntech, my work includes solution design, team guidance, and direct contributions to delivery. I have also worked on e-commerce integrations, management systems, and data analysis products.
aboutBio.paragraph3: My experience includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS. I am studying Software Engineering at Unicesumar, with expected completion in 2027.
